metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: I Wé Cudaiq gives birth to two more daughters, Wé Tenribalobo and Wé Tenridio; the latter is entered by a higher spirit and subsequently made a bissu-priest. I La Galigo travels to Luwuq to obtain certain bissu utensils for her. In Luwuq he marries Rajeng Risompa. When he returns to Cina, a small bissu house is built for the ordination of Wé Tenridio.
